title: 'Zero tolerance' on terror: Brics declaration strongly condemns Pahalgam attack
content: Brics countries strongly condemned the Pahalgam terrorist attack, reaffirming their commitment to combating terrorism.  The New Delhi Declaration 2026 opposed double standards and called for zero tolerance towards terrorism.  It also supported comprehensive UN reform, including Security Council expansion for developing nations.  China and Russia reiterated support for India and Brazil's greater UN roles.  The declaration also raised concerns over trade measures and unilateral sanctions.

title: Harvard University has a 'September message' for all international students
content: Harvard University has alerted international students about significant F-1 and J-1 visa rule changes. New Department of Homeland Security rules replace the duration of status system with fixed visa end dates. Students re-entering the US after September 15 will face stricter limits and new visa frameworks. Those already in the US before this date will generally retain current protections and benefits.

title: Indian-origin woman arrested in Canada after landlord-tenant dispute turns ugly

The tenant released viral footage accusing her of harassment and tampering with property. The conflict intensified, resulting in allegations of unauthorized entry and change of locks. Police intervened at Tiwana's residence, but the specific legal charges are yet to be disclosed.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: Pentagon wants AI to spot missile threats in 2 seconds before response window closes
content: The Pentagon is on the hunt for an advanced artificial intelligence system designed for swift threat detection. This innovative engine will integrate various sensor data to create a unified intelligence overview. It aims to process and deliver alerts in mere seconds, enabling rapid response to threats. Crucially, human oversight will play a vital role in monitoring progress and making informed decisions to adapt to evolving threats.

title: Trump’s childhood home bought for $835,000 sells for $1.93 million
content: The childhood home of Donald Trump, located in Queens, has been sold for an impressive $1.93 million. Originally bought for $835,000, this Tudor-style property underwent extensive renovations over eight months, transforming it into a contemporary five-bedroom residence. With ties to Trump's early years, its historical significance has notably heightened its market value.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars

US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: Nola Ochs took first college course in 1930; later became world’s oldest graduate
content: Nola Ochs, celebrating her 95th birthday, made headlines as the oldest college graduate in the world after earning her bachelor's degree from Fort Hays State University. Her academic pursuits began in 1930, but she put her education on hold to raise a family. At 98, she didn't stop there and accomplished the incredible feat of earning her master's degree, symbolizing a powerful testament to lifelong commitment to education.

title: Terrorism, trade, tariffs & wars: What's in India's hard-won Brics declaration
content: The New Delhi Declaration 2026 was unanimously adopted by BRICS nations at their summit.  This declaration emphasizes conflict prevention and the peaceful resolution of international disputes.  BRICS countries also backed stronger multilateralism and expressed concerns over unilateral trade measures.  Prime Minister Modi called for global governance reforms and greater Global South representation.  India is chairing BRICS in 2026 under a theme of resilience and cooperation.

title: 138 years later, England-Pakistan series creates rare Test cricket feat

The result gave England their second 3-0 Test series clean sweep over Pakistan, after their success in the 2022/23 series. It was also England's 15th three-match Test series sweep overall.
